newsitem.title: USA: USAir, pilots weigh low-cost operation- report.
newsitem.headline: USAir, pilots weigh low-cost operation- report.

text.p: USAir Inc. has been in talks with its pilots union about the creation of a low-cost operation between the Northeast and Florida, the Washington Post reported on Wednesday.
Quoting the pilots union and USAir sources, the newspaper said the operation would compete with a similar venture by Delta Air Lines Inc. and other no-frills carriers.
The air service would probably be marketed under a different name, much like Delta's low-cost Delta Express, which was launched this month, the paper said.
The pilots union told the Post it was first approached by USAir on the matter in August, and the union's leadership approved the talks on Sept. 20.

Before USAir can create a low-cost operation, it must secure concessions from its unions that would allow it to operate the new service under a different salary structure and work rules, the report said.
